creator: kaithevibecoder
title: Three vibe-coding site tools in 30 seconds: Componentry (free animated React components), Manus.im (backend-powered apps with analytics/SEO, sponsored), Realtime Colors (preview palette/fonts on a real site)

tools.name: Componentry
tools.detail: componentry.dev -- 'Components for React', animated components, free and copy-pasteable

tools.name: Manus.im
tools.detail: manus.im -- build backend-powered apps/websites with AI; built-in page analytics and SEO; sponsored (#manuspartner); comment 'Manus' for free credits

tools.name: Realtime Colors
tools.detail: realtimecolors.com -- test colour palette and fonts on a mock real website before building

claims: Componentry is a 'hidden gem': gorgeous animated components, all free and copy-pasteable
Manus.im is 'hands down the best tool for building backend-powered apps and websites with AI' and includes page analytics and SEO (sponsored claim)
Realtime Colors lets you see exactly how a palette and fonts look on a real site before you build
how_to_steps: Grab animated React components from componentry.dev and paste into your project
Use Manus.im to generate backend-powered sites with analytics/SEO (creator's sponsor)
Prototype your palette and typography on realtimecolors.com, then apply to the build
on_screen_only: Title: '3 years of vibe coding ball knowledge in 30 seconds' with a 30-second countdown timer
Tool cards: 'Componentry (componentry.dev)' with logo; 'Manus.im (manus.im)' with logo; 'Realtime Colors (realtimecolors.com)' with logo
Componentry site: 'Components for React'; Manus analytics dashboard with visitor stats (e.g. 2,728 / 1,236 / ... / 96.6%); Realtime Colors preview page with 'Visualize your colors on a real website'
cta: Comment 'Manus' for free credits and the list of sites

relevance.why: Two of the three (Componentry, Realtime Colors) are quick free wins for shipping nicer-looking apps fast; Manus is a sponsored pitch and competes with building in Claude Code.

implement_score.why: Add componentry.dev and realtimecolors.com to our design-ui reference list and point Claude Code at a chosen palette/components when scaffolding frontends. 20 minutes. Skip Manus.

verify: componentry.dev: real site, license (MIT?), React/Tailwind compatibility, maintenance
realtimecolors.com: free tier limits, export format (CSS vars/Tailwind config)
